boxes.text: The Macro Oscillator decouples modulation from timbre generation which allows you to experiment with various timbre generation modes without swapping oscillator modules
## Multiple oscillator models that share the same two CV modulation inputs ##

boxes.comment: CV3: pitch modulation input. This input has a built-in attenuator (CV3). At 100%, this will track 1v/oct. At 0%, no modulation will occur, even if something is connected at the CV3 input.
CV1: 1v/oct pitch modulation input. This input is typically used for keyboard tracking since there is no attenuator.
CV2: pitch modulation input. This input has a built-in attenuator (CV2). At 100%, this will track 1v/oct. At 0%, no modulation will occur, even if something is connected to the CV2 input.
